probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently amended) An apparatus for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising: an alignment device implemented as a tangible hardware component for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein said alignment device produces a functional change in the apparatus by automatically controlling display output based on the computed alignment.

2. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment and produces a control signal that causes a functional change in the apparatus.

3. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting constitutes a functional change in the user interface display.

4. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the current step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the current step based on the identification, wherein the highlighting constitutes a functional change in the user interface display.

5. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment and produces a control signal that causes a functional change in the apparatus.

6. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting constitutes a functional change in the user interface display.

7. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the next step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the next step based on the identification, wherein the highlighting constitutes a functional change in the user interface display.

9. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure, and wherein the alignment device compares the common strings to produce the alignment.

11. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, and wherein the previous user experiences are stored in a database accessible to the alignment device.

12. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the apparatus further comprises a document action extractor implemented as a tangible hardware component for extracting at least some of the plurality of steps.

13. (Currently amended) An apparatus for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the apparatus comprising: an alignment device implemented as a tangible hardware component for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein the alignment device produces a functional change in the apparatus; a highlighting device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device and implemented as a tangible hardware component, for visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the alignment computed by said alignment device, wherein the highlighting constitutes a functional change in the user interface display; and a scrolling device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device and implemented as a tangible hardware component, for automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the alignment computed by said alignment device, wherein the scrolling constitutes a functional change in the user interface display.
